events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, the iconic frontwoman of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Hynde's Enduring Influence
angles.copy: Seventy-five years young! Chrissie Hynde's distinctive voice and uncompromising style have left an indelible mark on rock music. What's your favourite Pretenders track?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman and rock 'n' roll icon Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday.

angles.name: King of Swagger
angles.copy: Our kid Liam Gallagher is 54 today! From Oasis anthems to his solo hits, his swagger and unmistakable vocals continue to define a generation.

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: James Bond Day marks the anniversary of the world premiere of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No,' in 1962.

angles.name: Shaken, Not Stirred
angles.copy: It's James Bond Day! Celebrating over six decades of espionage, iconic gadgets, and unforgettable theme tunes. What's your all-time favourite Bond film or song?

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we remember the legendary co-founder of The Beatles, John Lennon.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: Eighty-six years ago today, a musical visionary was born. John Lennon's songwriting genius and message of peace continue to resonate globally.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The celebrated English actor, comedian, and writer John Cleese, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: Comedy Legend
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the one and only John Cleese! From 'Ministry of Silly Walks' to 'Fawlty Towers,' his comedic brilliance is timeless.

events.title: Freddie Mercury: 35 Years On
events.blurb: Today marks 35 years since the passing of Queen's legendary frontman, Freddie Mercury, a true icon of rock music.

angles.name: A Voice Like No Other
angles.copy: Thirty-five years ago, the world lost a unique talent. Freddie Mercury's incredible voice and electrifying stage presence remain unparalleled. What's your favourite Queen anthem?

events.title: Rubber Soul: 61 Years On
events.blurb: The Beatles' influential album 'Rubber Soul' was released on this day in 1965 in the UK.

angles.name: A Pivotal Album
angles.copy: Sixty-one years since The Beatles delivered 'Rubber Soul'! This album marked a significant evolution in their sound. Which track is still on your playlist?

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: Commemorating the tragic anniversary of John Lennon's death in 1980.

angles.name: Lennon's Enduring Message
angles.copy: Forty-six years ago today, the world fell silent. Remembering John Lennon, whose music and message of peace continue to inspire.
